mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notifications (user_id, type, related_id, message, target_url) VALUES (#{userId}, #{type}, #{relatedId}, #{message}, #{targetUrl})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, type, related_id AS relatedId, message, target_url AS targetUrl, is_read AS isRead, created_at AS createdAt FROM notifications WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE notifications SET is_read = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notifications WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0
